findings.title: The app is debuggable
findings.description: android:debuggable="true" lets anyone with a USB or ADB connection attach a debugger, read the app's private data and run code in its process. Release builds must not be debuggable.

findings.title: App data can be backed up
findings.description: android:allowBackup is true: the app's private files and databases can be copied with adb backup or cloud backup. Set android:allowBackup="false" or restrict backups with android:fullBackupContent / dataExtractionRules.

findings.title: Cleartext HTTP traffic is allowed
findings.description: android:usesCleartextTraffic="true": the app may send data over unencrypted HTTP, readable and modifiable on the network.

findings.title: The app supports outdated Android versions (minSdkVersion 19)
findings.description: minSdkVersion 19 allows installation on Android versions before 6.0 (API 23), which no longer receive security updates and lack runtime permissions and current TLS defaults.

findings.title: Exported activity without a permission: .AdminActivity
findings.description: The activity .AdminActivity is exported (android:exported="true") and not protected by a permission: any app on the device can start or call it. Set android:exported="false" or require a signature-level permission.

findings.title: Exported service without a permission: .SyncService
findings.description: The service .SyncService is exported (android:exported="true") and not protected by a permission: any app on the device can start or call it. Set android:exported="false" or require a signature-level permission.

findings.title: Exported provider without a permission: .NotesProvider
findings.description: The provider .NotesProvider is exported (android:exported="true") and not protected by a permission: any app on the device can start or call it. Set android:exported="false" or require a signature-level permission.

findings.title: Signed with the v1 (JAR) scheme only
findings.description: The APK has only a v1 (JAR) signature. v1 does not protect the whole file: on Android 5.0-8.0 the Janus vulnerability (CVE-2017-13156) lets an attacker prepend DEX code without breaking the signature. Sign with the v2 or v3 scheme (apksigner).
